system.description: Usage held in 1 hand; Activate Interact (2 AP). Terrain: temperate or warm deserts and plains. Sunveil is a flat, yellow desert flower surrounded by a fringe of almost transparent petals. These petals fold tightly over the bloom at night, preserving a bead of fragrant amber oil at its centre. When the dried flower is crushed beneath the nose, it releases a warm vapour that floods the eyes with tears and clears spots from the vision. You remove the Dazzled condition unless it was caused by a permanent effect. Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.

effects.note: A Dazzled condition from a permanent effect returns — the GM puts it back.
